entities.name: Kishla Village
entities.description: Small fishing settlement on stilts in the Gudul delta swamps on Tarkir, a focal point of resistance to Silumgar.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: Sultai ruler whose forces tried to seize Kishla's harvest.

entities.name: Kotis
entities.description: Farmer who led the Kishla rebellion, was killed, resurrected as a sibsig and became Fangkeeper of the reformed Sultai.

entities.name: Sultai brood
entities.description: Clan that oppressed Kishla under Silumgar and was later reformed.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Kotis was killed.

events.summary: Kotis rallies the villagers into rebellion when Silumgar's forces try to seize the harvest; the rebels briefly gain independence before being driven into the jungle.
events.quote: the farmer Kotis , rallied the villagers into a rebellion

events.summary: Kotis is killed in the New Phyrexian Invasion and resurrected by the rebels as a sibsig.
events.quote: he was resurrected by the rebels through necromantic rituals

events.summary: Kotis rises to become Fangkeeper, leader of the reformed Sultai.

relations.quote: the new leader of the reformed Sultai
became a focal point of resistance during Silumgar 's reign
